metrics_definition.allocation: Wall-clock batch allocation duration divided by batch size, including API, locks, metadata and provider work.
metrics_definition.workflow: Per-round wall duration/completed operations, including worker dispatch/join and access validation; close separately timed.
metrics_definition.p50_p95: nearest index floor((N-1)*p+0.5), recomputed from every raw measurement
metrics_definition.ratios: candidate/baseline; below1 means lower duration but lower throughput ratio means worse throughput

limits: Exploratory native API workload; not formal product, end-to-end DEX/image, energy or release qualification.
CPU affinity/frequency and other system work uncontrolled; battery observations do not establish continuous thermal stability.
All original observations retained, no retries, exclusions, parameter changes or pooling across scopes/history.
First/last halves contain only two pairs each; descriptive temporal variation is not a causal trend or confidence interval.
No single-block case: frozen tiny fixed uses2 blocks and mixed4.
Discrete admission/occupancy and file hashes are not a shared device lock or signed mapped-page attestation.
